description: This source file contains an extension for the FileHandle class, adding safe reading methods that handle errors and avoid Objective-C exceptions, improving robustness when reading files.

methods.name: readToEndSafely()
methods.description: Reads from the file handle until EOF safely, returning empty Data on failure.

methods.name: readSafely(upToCount:)
methods.description: Reads up to the specified byte count safely, returning empty Data on failure or EOF.
